constraints.name: ck_conversation_memories_ready_embedding
constraints.sql: index_status <> 'ready' OR (embedding IS NOT NULL AND embedding_provider IS NOT NULL AND embedding_model IS NOT NULL AND embedding_dimension IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_conversation_memories_source_range
constraints.sql: source_start_position IS NULL OR source_end_position >= source_start_position

constraints.name: ck_credit_balances_amount
constraints.sql: balance >= 0 AND reserved_credit >= 0 AND reserved_credit <= balance

constraints.name: ck_credit_reservations_allocation
constraints.sql: (allocation_status = 'legacy_unknown' AND currency_code IS NULL AND free_amount IS NULL AND paid_amount IS NULL) OR (allocation_status = 'allocated' AND currency_code IS NOT NULL AND free_amount IS NOT NULL AND paid_amount IS NOT NULL AND free_amount >= 0 AND paid_amount >= 0 AND free_amount::numeric + paid_amount::numeric = reserved_credit)

constraints.name: ck_credit_reservations_state
constraints.sql: (status = 'reserved' AND result_id IS NULL AND transaction_id IS NULL AND finalized_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'committed' AND result_id IS NOT NULL AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND finalized_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'released' AND result_id IS NULL AND transaction_id IS NULL AND finalized_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_credit_transactions_operation
constraints.sql: (operation = 'legacy' AND currency_code IS NULL AND namespace IS NULL AND request_key IS NULL) OR (operation IN ('grant', 'consume') AND currency_code IS NOT NULL AND namespace IS NOT NULL AND request_key IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_credit_transactions_sign
constraints.sql: operation = 'legacy' OR (operation = 'grant' AND amount > 0) OR (operation = 'consume' AND amount <= 0)

constraints.name: ck_lorebook_entries_keyword_triggers
constraints.sql: activation_type <> 'keyword' OR is_enabled = false OR (key_triggers IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(key_triggers) > 0)

constraints.name: ck_messages_character_sender_has_character
constraints.sql: product_snapshot_id IS NULL OR sender_type <> 'character' OR product_character_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ck_moderation_actions_period
constraints.sql: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

constraints.name: ck_moderation_assessments_window
constraints.sql: (window_start IS NULL AND window_end IS NULL) OR (window_start IS NOT NULL AND window_end IS NOT NULL AND window_end > window_start)

constraints.name: ck_product_payment_parent
constraints.sql: (kind='sale' AND sale_id IS NULL) OR (kind='refund' AND sale_id IS NOT NULL)
